worker_claim.report: The implementation preserves unsafe or unproven conflicting workspaces and keeps the existing execution identity when a pre-worker repair succeeds.
worker_claim.summary: Added a shared read-only execution workspace inspection that classifies bound pre-worker state as REUSABLE, RECOVERABLE, or UNSAFE, preventing plans from advertising invalid resumes. Added identity-bound automatic repair for attributable stale execution branches, including durable checkpoint evidence, exact-head re-observation, CAS branch replacement from the persisted base, workspace reconstruction, and final revalidation.
